seo.title: Data Deletion — Noktah Inovasi Teknologi
seo.description: How to ask Noktah, Eskala and Venyu to delete your personal data, including data from connected Facebook Pages and Instagram and TikTok accounts.

hero.description: You can ask us to delete your personal data at any time. This page explains how, and what happens once we receive your request.

who.title: Who Can Ask
who.lead: This page applies to anyone whose data we process, including:
who.connected: Owners of Facebook Pages and Instagram or TikTok accounts that have been connected to our systems
who.clients: Clients and prospective clients of Eskala or Venyu
who.endUsers: Members and customers of venues that use Venyu
who.visitors: Anyone who has contacted us by email, WhatsApp or through this website

disconnect.title: First Step: Remove the App's Access
disconnect.lead: If your Facebook Page, Instagram or TikTok account is connected to us, you can remove our access directly on the platform. Menu names can differ slightly between app versions.
disconnect.facebook: In Facebook, go to Settings and privacy › Settings › Business integrations, then remove Noktah Hub Customer. If you connected through a business portfolio, also remove it in Meta Business Suite under Settings › Integrations › Connected apps. This also ends our access to the Instagram account linked to your Page.
disconnect.instagram: For an Instagram account connected on its own, not through a Facebook Page: go to Settings and activity › Website permissions › Apps and websites, then remove Noktah Hub from the active list.
disconnect.tiktok: Go to Settings and privacy › Security and permissions › App and services permissions, then remove Noktah Hub's access.
disconnect.note: Removing access stops us reading any new data, but it does not delete data we already hold. To delete that, send a request as described below.

request.title: Sending a Deletion Request
request.lead: Email {email} with the subject {subject}, and include:
request.includeService: What it relates to: Eskala, Venyu, a connected social media account, or your correspondence with us
request.includeAccount: An account identifier, such as your Facebook Page name or Instagram or TikTok username, or the email or phone number you registered with
request.includeScope: What you want deleted: everything, or only specific data
request.includeContact: An email address or number where we can confirm with you
request.mailBody:
Name:
Relates to (Eskala / Venyu / connected social media account / other):
Username or registered email:
Data to delete (all / part):
Contact for confirmation:
request.verify: To protect you, we will make sure the request really comes from the person the data belongs to, for example by asking you to reply from your registered email or to message us from the account concerned. We will never ask for your password.

process.title: What Happens Next
process.ackBody: We reply with a reference number you can use to check on your request, and ask for verification if needed.
process.verifyBody: Where needed, we ask for proof that the data or account is yours.
process.stopBody: Within 3 x 24 hours of receiving your request, we stop processing your data. Stored social media access tokens are deleted once your identity is verified.
process.deleteBody: The data is deleted from our primary systems. Copies in backups are removed as the backups roll over, within 30 days at most.
process.doneBody: Once deletion is complete we confirm in writing, and tell you about any data we are required to keep and why.

keep.title: Data We May Still Keep
keep.lead: In some cases we cannot delete everything straight away:
keep.legalBody: Financial and tax records, such as invoices and proof of payment, must be kept for 10 years under Indonesian tax law.
keep.claimsBody: Data needed to resolve a dispute, collect an unpaid amount, or defend our legal rights, until the matter is closed.
keep.aggregateBody: Data that has been combined or anonymised so it can no longer identify you or your account.
keep.recordBody: A short record of your request (your name, the date and the reference number) as proof that we carried it out.
keep.note: Anything we keep is access-restricted, not used for any other purpose, and deleted once the reason for keeping it ends.

clients.title: If Your Data Is Managed by One of Our Clients
clients.body: If you are a member of a venue that uses Venyu, or a patient or prospective patient of a healthcare facility that works with Eskala, your data is controlled by that venue or facility. We only process it on their behalf.
clients.forward: It is best to send your request to them directly. If you contact us instead, we will pass your request on to the client concerned and help them carry it out.

status.title: Status and Complaints
status.body: To check on a request, reply to our confirmation email or contact us quoting your reference number.
status.complaint: If you are not satisfied with our response, you can complain to Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), or to the personal data protection authority established under UU PDP.
status.policy: A full account of the data we collect and your rights is in our {link}.
